name: oreo-ui
description: Copy-paste React component library reproducing the Oreo UI design language on Base UI + Tailwind v4 + Motion

paragraphs: A small, copy-paste React component library that reproduces the Oreo UI design language on a modern headless stack. Built as a design-system reference: own the source, theme via tokens, animate with springs.
AI remix experiments → — five original components, five new capabilities and five independent Claude-inspired adaptations. All actions use identifiable browser-local demo data.
features: Inspired by Tailark’s Features 4, /feature-cards adds six composable exports: LayeredCard, InvoicePreview, SegmentedUsage, UsageSummary, FeaturePanel, and FeatureItem. The playground edits invoice fields, usage values…
